summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by BP p.l.c., a foreign private issuer, reporting routine disclosures under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. It contains two categories of information: (1) payment of the first-quarter 2026 interim dividend of US$0.0832 per ordinary share (US$0.4992 per ADS) in sterling, with no scrip alternative but a dividend reinvestment plan available, and (2) notifications of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs) under the BP ShareMatch UK Plan, involving ordinary share acquisitions by CFO Kate Thomson, Deputy CEO Carol Howle, and EVP Gordon Birrell at a price of approximately £5.293. None of these events represent a special situation—they are ordinary course dividend payments and routine PDMR share transactions.
